verdict.rationale: Riskified's docs show protection beyond checkout. A login decision API (Account Secure) returns allow/notify/challenge on customer-initiated login attempts, which covers account takeover. Policy Protect gives approve/review/decline recommendations on claim requests, which covers policy abuse. Both run on the same Riskified platform as order screening. Missing for 10: any evidence of scoring fake account creation or signups, explicit promo/coupon abuse detection, documentation of these surfaces being managed together in one unified analyst console, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
